# Crabionics Aquaculture Pvt. Ltd.

> Crabionics is an India-based deep-tech company developing biology-led production infrastructure and operating software for mud-crab aquaculture. The connected system is under development and validation; the website does not claim commercial-scale biological performance or completed hardware automation.

Canonical website: https://www.crabionics.com/
Company contact: info@crabionics.com

## What Crabionics is developing

- Individual mud-crab habitats and recirculating water systems (RAS): production infrastructure designed around animal care, operator access, water treatment and defined validation conditions.
- CrabSense: environmental observations tied to farm, cohort or habitat context; sensing and calibration work remain in development.
- CrabPod: local equipment connection under operator oversight; command, acknowledgement and response validation are not equivalent to deployed closed-loop automation.
- AquaOS: overarching operating software architecture for connected records, decisions and operating histories.
- CrabDesk: functional software prototype for individual-crab, crab-box and RAS operations.
- Crabee: separate functional pond-management software prototype serving pond and cohort workflows.
- Moltie: shared operator assistance across relevant AquaOS applications; demonstrated responses use sample data and must not be interpreted as field-validated operational recommendations.
- IHMS / HatchSync: hatchery monitoring and workflow research activity; it should not be mistaken for the name of the entire company platform. "Bio-OS" is not the current public name for AquaOS.

## Current evidence boundaries

- CrabDesk, Crabee and Moltie are functional software prototypes, not production-proven commercial deployments.
- The public CrabDesk demonstration uses example records. Manual observations and water-test entry do not establish live sensor-to-software integration.
- Habitat, RAS, sensors and local control require defined engineering and biological validation; predictive control or automatic biological-state detection is not presented as proven.
- The 600-box validation facility is proposed, not an established commercial production result.
- Institutional incubation and grant-funded research support do not constitute independent proof of commercial or biological performance.
